guardLocked.title: Lock the composer guard on
guardLocked.description: When true, the Maskroom guard is always on and the user cannot turn it off (bar toggle and options checkbox become inert). Set by administrators via managed policy; read-only to the user.

userId.title: Org user id for the audit trail
userId.description: Identifier (e.g. work email or employee id) sent with each request as X-Maskroom-User so the admin dashboard can attribute masking activity to this user. Set by administrators via managed policy.

orgId.title: Organization id
orgId.description: Optional organization/tenant identifier sent as X-Maskroom-Org.
